title: NTU RGB+D semantic validation (Route A: human-rated relevant body parts)

annotation.classes: all 60 NTU RGB+D 60 classes (annotation/classes.csv, official names, label id = action number - 1)
annotation.blind: action names only; sheets committed unchanged before ssat_part_scores.py runs (enforced by the scripts)

input_structure.zero_area_handling: kept in raw / lift (as in the report); dropped from the area-adjusted score

scores.metric: margin_drop (spatial_profile, averaged over operators and seeds)
scores.per_sample_group: mean over the group's regions within the sample
scores.S: mean over class samples (report class x semantic-group matrix)
scores.primary: lift L = per-group z-score of S across 60 classes, ddof 0
robustness: area-adjusted lift: residual of log1p(max(d,0)) on log(effective_area_px), pooled OLS over (sample, atomic part) pairs with positive area

metrics.agreement: linear weighted Cohen's kappa and raw agreement, per group and overall; relevant (>= 1) agreement
metrics.primary: mean class AUROC (relevant vs non-relevant groups, score L, ties 1/2) over classes with both; 95% percentile CI from 10,000 class bootstrap resamples; one-sided permutation p from 10,000 reassignments of annotation rows to classes
secondary: top-1 hit rate (highest-L group annotated primary; ties by group order) vs chance (mean primary share), permutation p
mean per-class Spearman between consensus ratings and L
metrics.representative_cases: top 3 and bottom 3 classes by AUROC (ties by label id)

interpretation_limits: human relevance is an external reference, not causal ground truth; no matched controls on NTU, so area effects are only partly removed
